(Brighella and Dorella have remained.)

Dorella.
Farewell, Signor Brighella. May the saints protect you!

Brighella (holding her back).
Stay just a moment longer!

Dorella.
Let me go.

To the point of madness! Is there nowhere I can meet you?

Oh? A rendezvous straight away? Very well, come to the end of the Corso this evening!

Damn it! It is usually very crowded there!

Dorella.

Ah, that will cost me my neck! Carnival is strictly forbidden; I must not risk it!

Dorella.

Brighella.
I will not do it!

Dorella.
Then go wherever you please! Goodbye!

I shall come as Colombine (Pierrot’s sweetheart), and you shall come as Pierrot so that I can recognise you!

Alas for me, as Pierrot!
